lines.zh: 这具笨重的身子，还是来了。
lines.en: This heavy body of mine came anyway.
Salmon, mine.

lines.zh: 两个头轮流看路，走得稳。
lines.en: My two heads take turns watching the path.
Nest, that's where I belong.
Move, make way for me.
Rumble, found prey.
Night, best time.
Flames don't affect me.
Be silent, here I come.
Salmon, time to eat.
Two heads sweep the nest, one fore and one aft.
Wings half spread, it hugs the rock wall.
Snoring, resting.
Grunting, digesting.
Safe in the nest.
Savoring the food.
Silent, unnoticed.
Rumbles, taking my time.
Night, most peaceful.
I am here, no one dares to move.
Grunting, waiting.

lines.zh: 夜里两股气从我的头里冒出来。
lines.en: At night two breaths rise from my two heads.
Its two heads doze, one left and one right.
It stashes salmon at the bottom of the nest.
By night it turns the nest over again.
One head keeps watch while the other yawns.
It only lies down once you strip your gear.
It licks the seams between its scales.
You moved, I'll check.
You're here, I can smell you.
Don't move, I'm hunting.
Come closer, I want to see you.
Too far, can't see you.
You moved, I'll chase you.
You're here, but I fear you not.
You moved, I'll check you.
Its two heads take turns sizing you up.

lines.zh: 它先闻你的手再闻武器。
lines.en: It sniffs your hand before your weapon.
It only comes closer when you crouch.

lines.zh: 它盯着你脚边那条鲑鱼。
lines.en: It stares at the salmon by your feet.
Screaming in agony
Shuddering in a low growl
Howling in pain
Squirming in misery
Screaming in despair

lines.zh: 两个头撞在一起，谁都不让。
lines.en: My two heads knock together and neither yields.
Whimpering in pain
Sobbing in pain

lines.zh: 两个头一起叫，声音有点乱。
lines.en: Both heads cry out, and the sound comes out tangled.
Sssing in pain

lines.zh: 它的眼睛闪烁着对鲑鱼的渴望。
lines.en: Its eyes gleam with the desire for salmon.

lines.zh: 我靠近它时，它发出低沉的嘶嘶声。
lines.en: It hisses low when I approach.

lines.zh: 它展开巨大的翅膀，准备迎接挑战。
lines.en: It spreads its enormous wings, ready for a challenge.

lines.zh: 鲑鱼的香味让它兴奋不已。
lines.en: The scent of salmon excites it greatly.

lines.zh: 它用爪子抓起一条鲑鱼，享受着美食。
lines.en: It claws a salmon and savors the meal.

lines.zh: 它在巢穴中蜷缩着，显得十分安心。
lines.en: It curls in the nest, appearing content.

lines.zh: 我小心翼翼地靠近，以免惊扰它。
lines.en: I approach carefully to avoid startling it.

lines.zh: 它会将未熟的鲑鱼藏在巢穴里。
lines.en: It hides uncooked salmon in its nest.
Patience is key to taming it.

lines.zh: 它的鳞片在月光下闪闪发光。
lines.en: Its scales shimmer in the moonlight.

lines.zh: 它的巨大身躯撞上了我的小屋。
lines.en: Its massive body crashes into my hut.

lines.zh: 两生物相撞，发出震耳欲聋的声响。
lines.en: They collide, creating a deafening sound.

lines.zh: 我躲闪不及，被它撞倒了。
lines.en: I dodge too late, and am knocked down.

lines.zh: 它的盔甲像铁一样坚硬，难以穿透。
lines.en: Its armor is as hard as iron, difficult to penetrate.

lines.zh: 我与它擦肩而过，感到一阵冷风。
lines.en: I brush past it, feeling a chill.

lines.zh: 它的撞击力让我踉跄后退。
lines.en: Its impact makes me stumble backward.

lines.zh: 它的尾巴扫过地面，发出巨响。
lines.en: Its tail sweeps the ground, creating a loud noise.

lines.zh: 我躲开了它的攻击，感到惊魂未定。
lines.en: I dodge its attack, feeling shaken.

lines.zh: 它的翅膀拍击声震动了整个山谷。
lines.en: Its wingbeats shake the entire valley.

lines.zh: 我迅速避开，以免被它撞飞。
lines.en: I move quickly to avoid being knocked away.

lines.zh: 它们彼此发出温柔的咕噜声。
lines.en: They emit soft grunts to each other.

lines.zh: 它用嘴温柔地摩擦它的伴侣。
lines.en: It gently rubs its mate with its mouth.

lines.zh: 它们在月光下亲密地缠绕在一起。
lines.en: They entwine in the moonlight.

lines.zh: 它伸出长舌轻触它的伴侣。
lines.en: It extends its long tongue to touch its mate.

lines.zh: 它们围绕着巢穴绕圈，展示爱意。
lines.en: They circle the nest, showing affection.

lines.zh: 它们相互低鸣，表达爱意。
lines.en: They coo softly to each other, expressing love.

lines.zh: 它们在月光下显得格外亲密。
lines.en: They appear particularly intimate in the moonlight.

lines.zh: 它用翅膀保护它的伴侣。
lines.en: It uses its wings to protect its mate.

lines.zh: 它们在巢穴中互相舔舐，显得亲密无间。
lines.en: They lick each other in the nest, seeming inseparable.

lines.zh: 它们之间的爱意让人心动。
lines.en: Their love is captivating.

lines.zh: 沉重的翅膀拍打声响起
lines.en: Heavy wings flapping sound

lines.zh: 我叼起鲑鱼，两个头一起咬。
lines.en: I take up the salmon, both heads biting.
Begins to slowly land on the ground

lines.zh: 用锋利的爪子在地上摸索
lines.en: Uses its sharp claws to dig in the ground

lines.zh: 张开大口露出锋利的牙齿
lines.en: Opens its mouth to reveal sharp teeth

lines.zh: 双头一起嗅，味道更清楚。
lines.en: Both heads sniff; the scent is clearer.

lines.zh: 用长舌舔食地面的食物
lines.en: Uses its long tongue to lick the ground
Makes a soft roar
Begins to eat the food in its claws

lines.zh: 发出轻微的咔嚓声咀嚼食物
lines.en: Chews food with soft crunches
Hunting target lock sound
Fixes eyes on the target

lines.zh: 两个脑袋一起嘶，鲑鱼味在那边。
lines.en: Both heads hiss; the salmon smell is that way.
Spreads its giant wings
Flaps its wings and glides

lines.zh: 夜里的风吹草动，我都听见了。
lines.en: Every rustle in the night wind reaches me.

lines.zh: 翅膀发出轻微的咔嚓声
lines.en: Wings make soft crackling sounds
Body suddenly accelerates
Makes a deep rumble
Spreads wings to fly towards the target

lines.zh: 你身上的铁味冲到了它。
lines.en: The smell of iron on you offends it.
It turns from the salmon to you.
The two heads confer in low hisses.
The dead branch you snapped is still settling.

lines.zh: 两颗头同时低头，气味对上了。
lines.en: Both heads dip as the scent matches.

lines.zh: 一个头看你，另一个头看我身后。
lines.en: One head watches you, the other our rear.

lines.zh: 咕哝声从两颗头中间漏出
lines.en: A grumble leaks out between my heads.

lines.zh: 我把巢挡在身后，慢慢侧移。
lines.en: I shift sideways with the nest behind me.

lines.zh: 左边那颗头先嘶了一声
lines.en: My left head hisses first.
Wings flutter gently
Wings make soft crackling sounds
Adjusts flying posture

lines.zh: 两个喉咙一起压出低吼
lines.en: Both throats grind out a low growl.

lines.zh: 两颗头，一个喷气一个点火。
lines.en: Two heads—one gasses, one lights it.
One head takes the left, one the right.
Its scales stand up like iron plates.
It puts itself between you and the nest.
Both necks dip at the same time.
No fire, just a slow advance.

lines.zh: 它张开巨大的颚，露出锋利的牙齿。
lines.en: It opens its massive jaws, revealing sharp teeth.

lines.zh: 沉重的鳞片在月光下闪着冷光。
lines.en: Heavy scales gleam in the moonlight.

lines.zh: 它喷出一团寒冰，冻结了四周。
lines.en: It spits a cloud of freezing frost.

lines.zh: 巨大的爪子在岩石上留下深深的痕迹。
lines.en: Its massive claws leave deep marks in the rocks.

lines.zh: 它俯冲下来，向猎物发起攻击。
lines.en: It dives down to attack its prey.

lines.zh: 它的翅膀扇动，发出低沉的嗡嗡声。
lines.en: Its wings flap, creating a low hum.

lines.zh: 它从巢穴中飞出，展开宽大的翼展。
lines.en: It flies out of its nest, spreading its wide wings.

lines.zh: 它用尾巴扫过地面，寻找食物。
lines.en: It sweeps its tail across the ground, searching for food.

lines.zh: 它用牙齿撕裂猎物的皮肉。
lines.en: It tears the flesh from its prey with its teeth.

lines.zh: 它的眼睛在黑暗中闪烁着凶光。
lines.en: Its eyes gleam with ferocity in the dark
Both jaws come down at once!
Fire cannot burn me. Are you afraid of it?
My wingbeat alone can knock you over!
Keep away from the salmon in my nest!

lines.zh: 巢穴中传来低沉的咕噜声。
lines.en: A deep rumbly sound comes from the nest.
It emerges slowly from the darkness.
A chill passes through the sky.

lines.zh: 两个头在争，今天吃哪条鱼。
lines.en: Two heads argue over which fish today.

lines.zh: 一声闷响，它降落到地上。
lines.en: A dull thud, it lands on the ground.
It leaps lightly onto the rock.

lines.zh: 一阵震动，它从地下爬出。
lines.en: A tremor, it emerges from underground.

lines.zh: 它在巢穴中伸展着身体。
lines.en: It stretches in its nest.
Two heads. One is snoring.
A chill emanates from the nest.
Night falls, and both heads rise in the nest.
A pair of shadows joins the cliff face.
The smell of salmon woke me.
You lit a fire in my territory.

lines.zh: 两个头，一颗心，都在盯着你。
lines.en: Two heads, one mind, both fixed on you.
This is not your valley.

lines.zh: 火伤不了我，只让我更清醒。
lines.en: Fire does not hurt me; it wakes me up.
Severe pain from the fall
Fear of drowning
Explosion impact
Arrow damage
Magical burn
Starvation torment
Lightning burn
Fear of the void
